meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 装上后,各官署在关键操作节点会把操作事件写入证据链,按 trace_id 串成可追溯链并生成向量索引条目;还能按 trace_id、时间窗或官署检索历史证据,支撑审计面板与回滚定位。
howto.when: 在构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时使用;各官署在派发、扫描、解析等关键操作节点会调用它写入证据链。

say.text: 把这次派发事件写入证据链,带上 trace_id
say.note: 会追加一条可追溯事件记录

say.text: 按 trace_id 检索这条链路的全部证据
say.note: 返回该链路串联的所有事件

say.text: 列出最近一小时某官署的操作证据
say.note: 按时间窗与官署维度检索

howto.what_en: It records each agent's key operations as events, chains them into a trace_id-based evidence chain, and adds vector index entries; past evidence can be queried by trace_id, time window, or agency for audit and rollback.
howto.when_en: Use it when building multi-agent systems that need end-to-end observability and security audit; agencies call it at key operations such as dispatch, scanning, and parsing to write the evidence chain.

say_en.text: Write this dispatch event into the evidence chain with its trace_id
Query all evidence for this trace_id
say_en.note: returns the events chained under it

say_en.text: List evidence for an agency in the last hour
say_en.note: queries by time window and agency
